title: GrowthBook closing call to action
description: A wide navy card with a 12px radius floating on a soft violet-and-mint glow band: a short question headline, one line of reassurance and a violet + outline button pair on the left, an art slot on the right. A bright sliver of light drifts back and forth along the card's bottom edge.
notes: the card forces the dark tokens (class dark); the band behind it is a backdrop slot (soft glow/highlight gradient when empty)
art slot: 480px square on desktop (top-right and smaller on phones); empty shows a soft glow
the edge light is a 15s CSS loop, still under reduced motion
